title: DISCO scaffold design pipeline parameters
description: DISCO de novo scaffold generation with LigandMPNN sequence design and side chain packing

input_json.description: Path to the DISCO input JSON file describing the design targets (motifs, ligands, sequence lengths)

ligand_file.description: Optional ligand structure file, referenced in the input JSON as 'FILE_<basename>'

experiment.description: DISCO experiment preset: 'designable' favours designability, 'diverse' favours structural diversity

effort.description: Compute effort: 'max' (200 diffusion steps) or 'fast' (100 diffusion steps)

num_designs.description: Number of inference seeds to run with DISCO (seeds are 0..N-1), one design per seed

ligandmpnn_run_parameters.description: Additional CLI arguments for the LigandMPNN sequence design step
